text:
Priya (FinOps): Quick thread to prep Helix QBR + cost ops. They're heavy on embeddings post-integration; onboarding status is 'in progress' but spend is spiking. Need a concise spend forecast, budget alerts, and an enablement plan. Who has the latest burn breakdown?
Alex (CS Ops): I pulled the last 30d trend. TL;DR: 3x embeddings calls -> projected 60% increase in monthly burn if unchanged. Gist with raw numbers: https://gist.github.com/redwood/helix-burn (will attach CSV).
Sam (AM): Tagging @Jordan for enablement. Helix wants a 'how-to' on batching and prefix caching. Also we should surface renewal sensitivity — their contract review is next month.
Jordan (Solutions): Can run a 30min enablement Wed 10am PT. Recommend we prep: demo KV prefix caching, show batching config, and present a simple fallback plan (compact model variant).
Priya (FinOps): Finance asks for an automated budget alert at $1200/day for now. Also propose a soft throttle at 90% of their monthly commit to avoid surprise invoices.
Alex (CS Ops): Added alert rule draft in Console: account=helixcorp, threshold=$1200/day, notify=#cs-helix + priya@redwood.com. Will finalize after Priya confirms.
Sam (AM): Renewal risk note: if daily spend > baseline * 2 for 2 weeks, flag as ‘at-risk’ and open AE -> customer conversation. Add to QBR agenda.
Jordan (Solutions): Quick QBR checklist I propose: 1) Spend snapshot + 30d projection, 2) Top token drivers + per-route breakdown, 3) Ops mitigations (batching/caching/quantize), 4) Enablement session + canary plan, 5) Renewal options and proposed commit, 6) Capture feedback and action items.
Priya (FinOps): Alex — can you produce per-route token breakdown and the top-5 prompt templates by token cost? I need numbers for the finance slide.
Alex (CS Ops): On it. Will upload CSV to /shared/qbr/helix/ by EOD. Sample snippet below:
```
route,avg_tokens_per_call,percent_calls
/chat/send,850,42%
/embeddings/upsert,1200,18%
/assistant/rerank,450,6%
```
Jordan (Solutions): Onboarding status for notes: data connector=done, SDK integration=60% (stubs out), test corpus size=~4.2M tokens. Recommend we prioritize embedding dedup and smaller context windows in the short term.
Sam (AM): Action items recap: @Jordan run enablement + record session, @Alex upload token CSV + enable compact-variant canary, @Priya finalize alert rule + slides, @Sam prepare renewal playbook and init customer meeting. I'll send invites after we confirm Wed 10am.
Priya (FinOps): Feedback capture — I'll draft a 6-question post-QBR survey focused on cost clarity, enablement usefulness, and appetite for commitments/discounts.
Alex (CS Ops): FYI I created a temporary fallback route `text-compact-1` that we can use for a 5% traffic canary to measure quality vs. cost.
Jordan (Solutions): Perfect. We'll mention the canary and the evaluation metric (acceptable quality delta <3%). If delta small, recommend a commit or tiered pricing.
Sam (AM): If canary meets targets, propose starting with a 3-month reserve at 20% commit to give immediate cost predictability.
Priya (FinOps): Calendar invites: sent. Draft slides: /shared/qbr/helix/draft-slides-v1.pptx. Alex — confirm the CSV link in thread when uploaded.
deploy-bot: Alert rule created for account helixcorp (rule id: ar-98234).
Priya (FinOps): Thanks everyone — will consolidate into the QBR deck and post a final agenda here by EOD. :thumbsup:
